name: design-doc
description: Write the technical design document a team reviews before coding, plus its ADR: current state, options with trade-offs, chosen approach, data and API changes, migration, rollback, risks, open questions, and who signs off. Use before code that touches a schema, a public contract, a shared module, or several services. `--spike` first investigates, time-boxed, a question the design cannot choose without; `--challenge` puts one agent per signing role on the draft; `--answer` records answers to its open questions. Triggers on: "design doc", "technical design", "tech design", "ADR", "architecture decision", "detail design", "how should we build this", "technical spike", "spike this", "pressure-test this design", "finish the draft design", "record the design answers", "/atk:design-doc".

findings.excerpt: /atk:design-doc <requirement-path>   # Design from an existing requirement artifact
